answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring nodes to lock capital in an orchard of validators to earn consensus weight. Unlike an open lagoon where cheap identities proliferate, this gatekeeping forces an attacker to acquire a majority of total supply, a cost that acts like a harsh zephyr blowing away malicious actors. By linking identity to verifiable economic risk, the protocol ensures that creating infinite fake agents remains computationally and financially prohibitive.
